queries.label: inference-cost-deployment

queries.label: real-time-distillation-deployment
queries.query: all:"video diffusion" AND (all:distill OR all:"few-step" OR all:"single-step")

queries.label: video-vae-mechanism
queries.query: all:"video VAE" OR all:"spatiotemporal VAE" OR all:"latent video compression"

queries.label: flow-matching-video-mechanism

queries.label: autoregressive-video-token-mechanism

queries.label: interactive-world-model-eval

queries.label: action-following-reliability-eval
